$comment: Prompts for tools/generate-art.mjs (Retro Diffusion). Each kind has its style, size and the approved sprites used as style references (art/references/<kind>/<id>.png). Approved sprites go to src/client/art/<kind>/<id>.png. The portraits are the starting look: plain clothes and empty hands, as characters start with nothing. portraits-evolved holds the prompts of the earlier, well-equipped portraits, kept in art/evolution/portraits/ for the look after the first class evolution.
